name: Gemma 4
about: The decoder stack of dense Gemma 4 text models (Hugging Face model_type gemma4_text). Each skeleton is what gemma4.build() makes of its checkpoint's config.json, pinned here (pinned); the generate binary writes them and checks they are unchanged. `generator` names the definition (`definition`, a module of this package) and where it was ported from (`derived_from`), whose output the port reproduces byte for byte. What the model is, and nothing of how a runtime runs it: how a LiteRT-LM graph binds to it is graph/bindings/gemma4.json.
